name: United Club Business Card

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees (confirmed on Chase product page).

categories.label: Hotel stays prepaid through Renowned Hotels and Resorts

rewards.redemption_notes: Miles redeemable via MileagePlus program for United flights and partner awards.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 100,000 bonus miles + 2,000 PQP after you spend $5,000 on purchases in the first 3 months your account is open. Plus, earn 10,000 bonus miles after you add an employee card in the first 3 months.

benefits.title: Unlimited United Club access for you and a guest
benefits.description: Your card includes United Club card membership — a $750+ value. Plus, unlock All Access membership when you reach Premier Gold status or spend $50,000 annually. Starting with your first anniversary, earn 4 United Club one-time passes when you have United Club All Access Membership and an employee card.

benefits.title: Free first and second checked bags
benefits.description: The primary Cardmember and one companion can each check a first and second standard bags for free – save up to $440 per roundtrip.

benefits.title: Up to $200 in credits annually (Renowned Hotels and Resorts)
benefits.description: Receive up to $200 back in statement credits each anniversary year on hotel accommodations when you prepay directly through Renowned Hotels and Resorts.

benefits.title: Up to $150 in credits on rideshare purchases
benefits.description: Enroll to receive up to $150 back as statement credits each calendar year on rideshare purchases: up to $12 back each month Jan-Nov and up to $18 back for December. Yearly opt-in required.

benefits.title: Up to $100 in United travel credits (Avis/Budget)
benefits.description: Receive $50 in United TravelBank cash, up to $100 each anniversary year, for your 1st and 2nd Avis or Budget car rentals booked directly through cars.united.com.

benefits.title: Up to $240 in Instacart credits
benefits.description: Receive two $10 Instacart credits monthly, up to $240 total each calendar year, for purchases made directly through Instacart. Benefits end 12/31/27.

benefits.title: Up to $200 in credits on JSX purchases annually
benefits.description: Get up to $200 back as a statement credit each anniversary year when you book flights directly with JSX.

benefits.title: Up to $50 in credits on United FareLock purchases
benefits.description: Earn up to $50 back as a statement credit each anniversary year after you buy FareLock on a United- or United Express-operated flight.

benefits.title: Premier Access travel services
benefits.description: Receive preferential treatment to ease your way through the airport with priority check-in, security screening, boarding, and baggage handling privileges (where available).

benefits.title: 2 global Economy Plus seat upgrades
benefits.description: Earn 2 global Economy Plus seat upgrades after spending $40,000 each calendar year.

benefits.title: Save 10% or more when booking flights with miles
benefits.description: Save 10% or more when booking flights with miles. Premier members save even more.

benefits.title: Earn up to 28,000 PQP
benefits.description: Earn 1 Premier Qualifying Point (PQP) for every $15 spent on purchases, up to 28,000 PQP per year.

benefits.title: Employee cards at no additional cost
benefits.description: Miles earned from employee purchases accrue in your account. Set up individual spending limits for each card.

benefits.title: 5,000-mile better-together bonus
benefits.description: Receive a 5,000-mile better-together bonus each year when you have the United Club Business card and a personal United credit card.

lounge_access.notes: Unlimited United Club access for cardmember and guest ($750+ value)

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: Free first and second checked bags for primary cardmember and one companion (save up to $440 per roundtrip)

notes: Verified against official Chase product page 2026-07-24. Name updated to 'United Club Business Card'. APR 19.74%-28.24% variable confirmed. Annual fee $695 confirmed. Signup bonus confirmed (100,000 miles + 2,000 PQP after $5,000 in 3 months). FX fee not explicitly stated on page.
